segments.name: Gold operations
segments.description: Mines and processes gold from South African shafts, surface operations and the Hidden Valley operation.
segments.evidence: Our reportable segments are as follows: Gold operations

segments.name: Copper operations
segments.description: Produces copper at CSA, an underground copper mine in Australia, sold under offtake arrangements.
segments.evidence: During fiscal 2026 , CSA produced 18,207 tonnes of copper at a yield of 3.75% .

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for gold and copper sold, with copper sales priced provisionally against market prices.
revenueModel.evidence: Most of our revenue is derived from the sale of gold and copper.

changes.text: Copper operations became a reportable segment in fiscal 2026 after the MAC Copper acquisition.
changes.evidence: Fiscal 2026 is the first year in which our results include a producing copper business.
